automation.cutoverRule: Transfer only after the new machine and receiving chat pass read-only acceptance and the old production control channel has been fenced. Preserve schedule, status and notification settings; replace target ownership and any embedded old thread identifier.

newMachineSequence: Clone or update the repository and resolve every path from the repository root.
Verify the intended main revision and read every authoritative document before changing configuration.
Install local interpreters, browser-post dependencies, WeCom native UI provider and the four isolated browser posts without copying credentials or session stores.
Keep the old machine as the sole production owner while running offline checks and synthetic non-production validation.
At an explicit cutover window, verify no live step or production lock, fence the old scheduler, then transfer Goal and all five automations exactly once.
Recreate login state through normal user login when required; recheck business text, risk overlays, queues, ledgers and anti-duplication identity on the new machine.
Use normal scheduled business runs to obtain new-machine real receipts before declaring migration accepted.
hardStops: Do not copy Cookie, localStorage, keychain, browser profile credentials or authentication API material.
Do not run old and new production schedulers at the same time.
Do not reset ledgers, cursors or anti-duplication state.
Do not resend attempted, unknown or already verified business events.
Do not restart or stop the old machine as part of this documentation-only update.
Do not claim migration completion from documentation, tests or old-machine health.
